verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents its own human-review capability: custom annotation interfaces built around a team's review workflow (braintrust-docs-12), and scoring outputs 'with LLMs, code, or humans' (braintrust-docs-68), which together cover human review and labeling of outputs. Nothing in the evidence describes queues or a way to route specific outputs or traces to reviewers, so only part of the story is shown. Missing for 10: a documented annotation-queue feature, rules for routing or assigning outputs to reviewers, in-depth docs on the labeling workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
